units.raw: A. The Parties are exploring a potential business relationship concerning enterprise workflow automation, logistics platform integration and related software services (the "Purpose").

units.raw: C. This Agreement sets forth the conditions under which such information will be shared, maintained and protected.

units.raw: 2.2 The Recipient shall apply the same degree of care to safeguard the Discloser's Confidential Information as it applies to its own confidential material of like character, but in no event less than a reasonable commercial standard of care.

units.raw: 5.1 If the Recipient or any of its Affiliates is requested or ordered by a court, regulatory body or government agency to disclose any of the Discloser's Confidential Information, the Recipient shall immediately notify the Discloser in writing to the extent legally permissible.
